name: rollback_winner_v3c_full_locked_v1_0
intent: Per-epoch rollback guardrails that tune z_weak and z_fill_min using last-N backtest; decision engine is Winner C with soft-fill alignment in weak-z zones.

required_inputs: DB_epoch_ochlv_merged_with_call15_ochlv.csv (epoch-level rows; must include call15_C, truth_call15, Next Epoch Time, previousEpoch)
DB_epoch_ochlv_merged.csv (raw OCHLV tick rows; must include Timestamp, Close, Volume, previousEpoch)
notes: call15_C is used ONLY for logret/z computation at decision_time.
Tick OCHLV stream is used for EMA20 slope (fast sign), VWAP300 sign, and near0 volume gate (mean vol over last 90s ending at decision_time).

b1_core.weak_agree_rule: if not strong then allow fast_sign only when fast_sign == vwap_sign

soft_alignment.rule: During fill step ONLY: if |z| < z_align then require dir_lr == fast_sign and fast_sign != 0; else allow fill normally.

slope_weak_threshold.rule: Used ONLY inside DISAGREE-neutral corner: if abs(slope) < slope_thr and abs(z) < z_weak then Neutral when DISAGREE+flip_flag.

stages.rule: pred_b1 = fast_sign if strong; else pred_b1 = fast_sign only if fast_sign == vwap_sign; else 0
dir_lr = sign(z) where z = EMA(logret(call15_C), 20) / STD(logret(call15_C), 240)
If pred_b1==0 AND not near0 AND not flip_flag AND dir_lr!=0 AND |z|>=z_fill_min then pred_fill=dir_lr; else pred_fill=pred_b1
notes: Soft alignment rule applies only inside this fill stage.

stages.rule: If near0 then only keep prediction when (pred_fill!=0 AND pred_fill==dir_lr); otherwise force 0; if not near0 keep pred_fill
Define DISAGREE = (not near0) AND flip_flag AND (pred_b1!=0) AND (dir_lr!=0) AND (pred_b1!=dir_lr). If DISAGREE AND |z|<z_weak AND |slope|<slope_thr then final_pred=0 else final_pred=pred_after_near0

objective.primary: maximize run_accuracy over last lookback (BullRun+BearRun subset)
objective.secondary: maximize pnl_bnb over last lookback (using pnl_model and wager_bnb_default)

notes: Each epoch i: evaluate candidate grid on window [i-L, i-1], pick best lexicographically, shrink-update knobs, then predict epoch i using updated knobs.
VOL_NEAR0, K_MAD, flip_flag params are FIXED in this locked version.

what_was_tested: Winner chosen on FULL dataset vs baseline Winner C fixed (same eval range): +1.187pp overall accuracy, +0.846pp run-accuracy mean, +1.494pp flip accuracy, with ~5.04pp lower coverage.
how_to_recompute_slope_thr: Compute EMA20 on tick Close stream (tick-level).
For each epoch (previousEpoch), take the LAST tick row belonging to that epoch as the anchor.
Collect abs(slope20_anchor) across all epochs used, then set slope_thr = quantile(abs_slope, 0.40).
If dataset changes, update slope_thr value accordingly and re-lock.
how_to_recompute_near0: At decision_time (NextEpochTime-15s), compute mean Volume over last 90 seconds from tick stream; near0 = mean_vol <= 0.05.
how_to_recompute_vwap_sign: At epoch anchor time, compute VWAP over last 300 seconds from tick stream (sum(price*vol)/sum(vol)); vwap_sign = sign((Close_anchor - VWAP)/VWAP).
truth_definition: truth_call15 must reflect the epoch outcome you are targeting (Bull/Bear) using the 15-sec call window truth convention.
minimum_viable_debug_prints: For each epoch: i, previousEpoch, z, dir_lr, flip_flag, mean_vol_90s, near0, fast_sign, vwap_sign, pred_b1, pred_fill, DISAGREE, z_weak, z_fill_min, final_pred, truth
